python3 - <<'EOF'
import hashlib, json, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/replay-pcsj1hh2')
out = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/adapters-qc'); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
before = {}
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts:
        before[str(p.relative_to(root))] = sha(p.read_bytes())
expected = dict(before); n = 0
for rel in before:
    if rel.startswith('adapters/a') and rel.endswith('.py'):
        b = (root/rel).read_bytes()
        assert b.count(b'VERSION = 1\n') == 1 and b'VERSION = 2' not in b, rel
        expected[rel] = sha(b.replace(b'VERSION = 1\n', b'VERSION = 2\n', 1)); n += 1
json.dump(before, open(out/'before.json','w'), indent=1)
json.dump(expected, open(out/'expected.json','w'), indent=1)
print('tracked files:', len(before), '| adapters with exactly one VERSION = 1:', n)
EOF
